source.author: ov
source.text: Aliqua et mihi gratia ponto est, si tamen in medio quondam concreta profundo spuma fui Graiumque manet mihi nomen ab illa.
source.text_original: Aliqua et mihi gratia ponto est, / si tamen in medio quondam concreta profundo / spuma fui Graiumque manet mihi nomen ab illa.'
source.text_english: I too have some favor with the sea, if indeed once, hardened in the middle of the deep, I was foam, and from that foam the Greek name still remains with me.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Interea medio saevus permissa profundo carbasa Pangaea Boreas speculatus ab arce continuo Aeoliam Tyrrhenaque tendit ad antra concitus.
reuse.text_original: Interea medio saevus permissa profundo / carbasa Pangaea Boreas speculatus ab arce / continuo Aeoliam Tyrrhenaque tendit ad antra / concitus.
reuse.text_english: Meanwhile, from the Pangaean citadel, fierce Boreas, having surveyed the sails entrusted to the deep in mid-ocean, at once, roused, speeds toward Aeolia and the Tyrrhenian caves.
